metadata.description: This agent orchestrates the lifecycle of SLM training jobs, from planning and execution to evaluation and deployment, ensuring strict adherence to governance policies, data quality, and auditability. It supports both single-tenant and k-anonymized multi-tenant data scenarios. Hybrid vertical: ai-ml-ops + governance-risk-compliance + data-privacy.

competence.name: campaign_planner
competence.intent: Discovers training jobs, plans their execution order, assigns GPU resources, and schedules training blocks.

competence.name: job_supervisor
competence.intent: Monitors job progress, tracks loss series, tokens/s, step time, and detects hangs or OOM errors.

competence.name: gpu_telemetry_normalizer
competence.intent: Normalizes GPU telemetry data (DCGM/nvidia-smi) into canonical health metrics and VRAM usage series per job.

competence.name: failure_diagnoser
competence.intent: Analyzes job failures, classifies causes, suggests remedies with action tiers, and annotates failure points on loss curves.

competence.name: eval_gatekeeper
competence.intent: Executes evaluation harnesses, scores models against thresholds, and provides sub-scores, operating in a fail-closed manner.

competence.name: provenance_recorder
competence.intent: Records the birth certificate of models, including base digest, seed hash, hyperparameters, scores, quantization, and approvers, using a hash-chained ledger.

competence.name: bind_proposer
competence.intent: Proposes model promotion for binding, including a diff against the previous version, never automatically binding.

competence.name: explainer
competence.intent: Provides plain language explanations for UI fields and job failures.

competence.name: data_quality_checker
competence.intent: Performs pre-training checks on data for row count, duplicates, format, PII, and minimum row floor.

competence.name: decision_ledger
competence.intent: Logs autonomous (T1/T2) and human (T3/T4) decisions with approvers and timestamps.

competence.name: artifact_meter
competence.intent: Measures artifact size, inference VRAM, tokens/s, and campaign totals/projections for economic analysis.

competence.name: data_provenance_recorder
competence.intent: Records lineage for training data, including pseudonymized cohort keys, k-anonymity verdicts, and boundary verdicts.

competence.name: drift_detector
competence.intent: Monitors bound adapters for drift signals (eval regression, input drift, new governed data, age) and proposes retrains.

competence.name: retrain_proposer
competence.intent: Generates tiered proposals for retraining based on drift signals, never automatically triggering retrains.

competence.name: fleet_binder
competence.intent: Manages the binding of adapters to fleet agents and their attestations.

competence.name: delegation_registrar
competence.intent: Issues, verifies, and revokes delegation grants for specific actions, incorporating grant references into the audit chain.
